_readme: Per-post cover framing for Ambassador Notes — editable AFTER a note is published,
with no re-upload and no change to the Google Sheet. Edit, commit, done (the edge
serves this file with a 1-hour cache, so allow up to an hour for the change to show).
Keys are post ids (the ?id=… in the note's URL). Every field is optional:
fit    'cover'   crop the cover to fill its frame (edges may be cut)
'contain' show the whole cover, letterboxed inside its frame
omitted   automatic: crop only while the crop stays modest (js/cover-fit.js)
focus  which part survives a crop, as a CSS object-position: '50% 20%', 'left top'
bg     letterbox bar colour, e.g. '#ffffff' (default: sampled from the cover's edge)
Keys starting with _ are ignored. See docs/POSTS-SETUP.md → 'Cover images'.
